lines: Tatrāyaṃ saṅkhepattho – yo pubbe sabhayo attani avissattho ahosi, tasmiṃ avissatthe, yo pubbepi nibbhayo attani vissāsikoyeva, tasmiṃ vissatthepi na vissase, neva vissāsaṃ kareyya.
Kiṃkāraṇā?
Vissāsā bhayamanveti, yo hi mittepi amittepi vissāso, tato bhayameva āgacchati.
Kathaṃ?
Sīhaṃva migamātukā, yathā mittasanthavavasena katavissāsāya migamātukāya santikā sīhassa bhayaṃ anveti, upagataṃ sampattanti attho.
Yathā vā vissāsavasena sīhaṃ migamātukā anvetā upagatātipi attho.

after.title: [93] 3. Vissāsabhojanajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Evaṃ bodhisatto sampattaparisāya dhammaṃ desetvā dānādīni puññāni katvā yathākammaṃ gato.

after.title: [93] 3. Vissāsabhojanajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Satthā imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ āharitvā jātakaṃ samodhānesi –
“tadā mahāseṭṭhi ahameva ahosi”nti.

after.title: [93] 3. Vissāsabhojanajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Vissāsabhojanajātakavaṇṇanā tatiyā. [94] 4.

after.title: [94] 4. Lomahaṃsajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Lomahaṃsajātakavaṇṇanā

after.title: [94] 4. Lomahaṃsajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Sotatto sosinno cevāti idaṃ satthā vesāliṃ upanissāya pāṭikārāme viharanto sunakkhattaṃ ārabbha kathesi.
Ekasmiñhi samaye sunakkhatto satthu upaṭṭhāko hutvā pattacīvaramādāya vicaramāno korakkhattiyassa dhammaṃ rocento dasabalassa pattacīvaraṃ niyyādetvā korakkhattiyaṃ nissāya vasati.

Tassa kālakañjikaasurayoniyaṃ nibbattakāle gihi hutvā “natthi samaṇassa gotamassa uttari manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso, takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃsānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ.
Yassa ca khvāssa atthāya dhammo desito, na so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā”ti (ma. ni. 1.146) vesāliyaṃ tiṇṇaṃ pākārānaṃ antare vicaranto satthu avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.

after.title: [94] 4. Lomahaṃsajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Athāyasmā sāriputto piṇḍāya caranto tassevaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsantassa sutvā piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto tamatthaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
Bhagavā “kodhano, sāriputta, sunakkhatto moghapuriso, kodhavasenevamāha, kodhavasenāpi pana ‘na so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā’ti vadanto ajānitvāpi mayhaṃ guṇameva bhāsati.
Na kho pana so moghapuriso mayhaṃ guṇaṃ jānāti.
Mayhañhi, sāriputta, cha abhiññā nāma atthi, ayampi me uttarimanussadhammova.
Dasabalañāṇāni atthi, catuvesārajjañāṇaṃ atthi, catuyoniparicchedakañāṇaṃ atthi, pañcagatiparicchedakañāṇaṃ atthi, ayampi me uttarimanussadhammova.

Evaṃ uttarimanussadhammasamannāgataṃ pana maṃ yo evaṃ vadeyya ‘natthi samaṇassa gotamassa uttarimanussadhammo’ti, so taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye”ti evaṃ attano vijjamānaṃ uttarimanussadhammassa guṇaṃ kathetvā “sunakkhatto kira, sāriputta, korakkhattiyassa dukkarakārikāya micchātape pasanno, micchātape pasīdantena pana mayi eva pasīdituṃ vaṭṭati.

Ahañhi ito ekanavutikappamatthake ‘atthi nu kho ettha sāro’ti bāhirakaṃ micchātapaṃ vīmaṃsanto caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ brahmacariyavāsaṃ vasiṃ, tapassī sudaṃ homi paramatapassī, lūkho sudaṃ homi paramalūkho, jegucchī sudaṃ homi paramajegucchī, pavivitto sudaṃ homi paramapavivitto”ti vatvā therena yācito atītaṃ āhari.

after.title: [94] 4. Lomahaṃsajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Atīte ekanavutikappamatthake bodhisatto “bāhirakatapaṃ vīmaṃsissāmī”ti ājīvakapabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā acelako ahosi rajojalliko, pavivitto ahosi ekavihārī.
Manusse disvā migo viya palāyi, mahāvikatibhojano ahosi, vacchakagomayādīni paribhuñji, appamādavihāratthāya araññe ekasmiṃ bhiṃsanake vanasaṇḍe vihāsi.
Tasmimpi viharanto himapātasamaye antaraṭṭhake rattiṃ vanasaṇḍā nikkhamitvā abbhokāse viharitvā sūriye uggate vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati.
So yathā rattiṃ abbhokāse himodakena tinto, tatheva divā vanasaṇḍato paggharantehi udakabindūhi temayi.
Evaṃ ahorattaṃ sītadukkhaṃ anubhoti.
Gimhānaṃ pana pacchime māse divā abbhokāse viharitvā rattiṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati.
So yathā divā abbhokāse ātapena pariḷāhappatto, tatheva rattiṃ nivāte vanasaṇḍe pariḷāhaṃ pāpuṇāti, sarīrā sedadhārā muccanti.
Athassa pubbe assutapubbā ayaṃ gāthā paṭibhāsi – 94.

after.title: [94] 4. Lomahaṃsajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: “Sotatto sosinno ceva, eko bhiṃsanake vane;

after.title: [94] 4. Lomahaṃsajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Naggo na caggimāsīno, esanāpasuto munī”ti.
3-vissāsabhojanajātakavaṇṇanā (93)
apaccavekkhitvā paribhogaṃ katvā hi kālaṃ kurumāno bhikkhu yakkhapetaattabhāvato na muccatīti idaṃ upalakkhaṇavasena vuttaṃ.
bhagavā hi katthaci desanāvilāsatāya vohārakusalatāya vā upalabhitabbatthesu ekadesamattameva gahetvā sāvasesaṃ katvā dhammaṃ desesi.
yaṃ pana littajātake “tasmiṃ kira kāle bhikkhū cīvarādīni labhitvā yebhuyyena apaccavekkhitvā paribhuñjanti.
te cattāro paccaye peccavekkhitvā paribhuñjamānā yebhuyyena nirayatiracchānayonito na muccantī”ti aṭṭhakathācariyena vuttaṃ.
taṃ tasmiṃ kāle cattāro paccaye apaccavekkhitvā paribhogaṃ katvā kālaṅkatabhikkhuyeva sandhāya vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
ettha ca yakkhapetaattabhāvatoti yakkhasaṅkhātapetānaṃ attabhāvato.
yakkhapetayonitoti attho.
yakkhā ca nāma ahetukā tihetukācāti duvidhā.
tattha ahetukā icchitabbāti yakkhapetaattabhāvatoti petasaddena visesetvā vuttaṃ.
yakkhapetaattabhāvatoti iminā catūsu apāyesu pettivisayaṃ upalakkhetvā avasesāpi gahetabbāti dasseti.
cattāro paccaye apaccavekkhitvā paribhuñjantānaṃ taṇhāmānadiṭṭhiādayo kilesā vaḍḍhanti.
te pana kilesā satte catūsu apāyesu nibbattenti.
sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāyāti ādinā paccavekkhitvā paribhuñjantānaṃ pana supaṭṭhitasatiyā ānubhāvena kilesā nuppajjanti.
teneva bhagavā satiṃ anuṭṭhāpetvā cattāro paccaye apaccavekkhitvā paribhuñjamānānaṃ taṇhāmānadiṭṭhādikilesuppattiṃ nivāretuṃ paccavekkhaṇavidhipaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammadesanaṃ kathesi.
sakalampi hi dhammadesanaṃ veneyyānaṃyeva atthāya kathesi.
yasmā pana bhagavā mahākaruṇāpubbaṅgamavasena veneyyānaṃ atthaṃ ākaṅkhamāno taṃ taṃ dhammadesanaṃ kathesi.
tasmā bhagavato veneyyasattesu mahākaruṇatā caturāsītiyojanasahassapamāṇena sinerunāpi upamānetuṃ na sakkāyeva.
teneva paṇḍitehi bhagavato mahākaruṇataṃ yathābhūtaṃ jānantehi ṭhapetvā bhuñjamānakālaṃ sāyamānakālañca vandanāmānapūjāsakkārādīni kātabbāni yevāti.
gopālakoti paresaṃ vetanaṃ gahetvā gavaṃ pālako.
vuttañca suttanipātaṭṭhakathāyaṃ [suttani. ṭṭha. 1. 25] “yo hi attano gāvo pāleti.
so gopoti vuccati.
yo paresaṃ vetanena bhaṭo hutvā.
so gopālakoti.
etepi dve vassanimittaṃ jānanti.
yadā sakuṇikā kulāvakāni rukkhagge karonti.
kakkaṭakā udakasamīpaṃ dvāraṃ pidihitvā thalasamīpadvārena vaḷañjanti.
tadā suvuṭṭhikā bhavissatīti gaṇhanti. [suttani. ṭṭha. 1. 24] yadā pana sakuṇikā kulāvakāni nīcaṭṭhāne udakapiṭṭhe karonti.
kakkaṭakā thalasamīpaṃ dvāraṃ pidahitvā udakasamīpadvārena vaḷeñjanti.
tadā dubbuṭṭhikā bhavissatīti gaṇhantīti. kiṭṭhasambādhasamayeti sassena sambādhakāle.
sassaṃ hi kīṭati gacchati pavattatīti kiṭṭhaṃ nāma.
kīṭa-gatiyanti dhātu.
kasito vā sambhūtaṃ kiṭṭhaṃ.
kiṭṭhaṭṭhāne uppannasassaṃ hi kiṭṭhanti vuccati ṭhānūpacārena.
sīhasantāsenāti sīhassa bhayena.
milātānanti kisānanti attho.
mandanti appaṃ.
paṭibandhenāti sinehavasena paṭibandho.
migamātukāyāti sabbesaṃ migānaṃ mātuṭṭhāne patiṭṭhānatāya evaṃ nāmikāya migavisesāya.
yā loke “proṅ”iti vuccati.
etesaṃ hi sabbesaṃ tajjātikamigavisesānaṃ sādhāraṇatāya itthiliṅgavasena vuccati.
katthaci hi itthiliṅgavasena pumitthinampi sādhāraṇanāmaṃ hoti.
yathā godhā, sālikā, devatāti.
jīvaggāhanti saha jīvena gāhaṃ.
saha jīvena gahetabbaṃ gahetunti attho.
lehitvā sāyitvā.
jivhāya cumbitvāti attho.
paresu sineho nāma na kātabboti paresu taṇhābandhava vasena sineho na kātabbo.
avisaṭṭhe3ti sabhayattā attani avisaṭṭhe.
visaṭṭheti nibbhayattā attani visaṭṭhe.
avisaṭṭhepi na vissase.
visaṭṭhepi na vissaseti yojanā.
imamatthaṃyeva dassetuṃ “yo pubbe”ti ādimāha.
tatoti vissāsamittato.
sīhantiettha sampadānatthe upayogavacanaṃ.
migamātuyā [migamātukā (ṭṭha)] ti ettha sāmiatthe chaṭṭhīvacanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
tañca santikāti pāṭhasesena sambandhitabbaṃ.
tenāha “yathā hī”ti ādi.
atha vā pana migamātukāti vattabbe ka-kārassa ya-kāraṃ katvā migamātuyāti vuttaṃ.
tañca kattubhāvena anvetī [anvetā.(ṭṭha)] ti iminā sambandhitabbaṃ.
tenāha “yathā vā”ti ādi.
anveti ākhyātapadaṃ pana aliṅgattā tiliṅgasādhāraṇattā ca upagatanti upagatātipi attho sambhavati yevāti.
vissāsabhojanajātakavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā.
